name: exa
description: Exa's hosted MCP server: agents search the web and read pages as clean text, with your own Exa API key.

setup.title: Create an Exa API key
setup.body: Sign in to the Exa dashboard, open API Keys and create a key just for xaq (any name, for example xaq). Copy it: you paste it here next.

setup.title: Paste the key
setup.body: Paste the key as the API key. xaq stores it encrypted and sends it as the `x-api-key` header on every request to Exa. Searches count against your Exa account's credits.

setup.title: What agents can do
setup.body: Two tools, both read only: `web_search_exa` searches the web and returns each result's title, URL and text, and `web_fetch_exa` reads pages at URLs the agent gives it. Neither changes anything, but what an agent searches for or fetches is sent to Exa.
